Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-20-film-compiler-phase-plan.md
Phase-plan ticket: bd-01M2TAGST4EBFR1HM9Q3EWSYAH
Film parent: bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P

This ticket is an executable child created from the cold-reviewed filing payload. Its blocking edges are authoritative; parent relation is organizational only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Cite the recorded owner answer; implement only that alternative with an explicit family-specific license rule rather than copying text SurfaceExplicit assignments.
2. Alternative A preserves the span law: caption/model-only conjecture is Hypothesized with complete derivation; HumanAdjudicated needs a record for the particular emitted claim. Alternative B first records the changed meaning and adds the checked derivative basis to construction, join, component disclosure and consistency checks.
3. Same sentence as source text versus film derivative remains distinguishable. High raw score or accepted resolution alone cannot license film SurfaceExplicit; human authorship alone is not specific adjudication.
4. Join expected source bundle, recipe/model/request, output-bound caption proposal, receipt and sampled-frame inventory. Substitution and borrowed licenses on another bundle refuse.
5. Keep caption hull and exact sampled-frame inventory distinct; preserve claim-union gaps and text StatusWeight/calibrated override semantics.
6. A lawful film control and compiled deletion of the selected license/provenance guard establish that the policy fires. Selected public basis/component changes have explicit ADR and API/wire inventory entries.

Required gates:
- Separate committed-source SD6 cold review with findings resolved.
- Named compiled mutations and independent accepting controls; compile-door witnesses clean both Compile and Test and prove both recompilations.
- Clean exact-candidate standalone provider compileAll/testAll, separate format checks, frozen S0 values and applicable WOG backend byte court.
- Executable docs examples for public API changes; exact-pinned storyatlas consumer suite when its dependencies or interfaces are touched.
- Local evidence and commits only; no push or scientific/CI qualification implied.

Scope limits:
- Blocked until owner answer; no policy inferred from this payload. No generic model-wire or calibrated truth claim.

Plan sections: §7.
set.title: [film] implement the owner-selected explicit film claim license
